column1: # Replay corpus for sentinel-check: every fault signature the sentinel actually recorded in
# ~/agents/sentinel/state/sentinel.log over the 7 days to 2026-09-07, plus the healthy tick,
# the escalation-cooldown repeat and the pipewire log.level reset.
# Columns, "|"-separated (not tab: tab is IFS whitespace, so empty columns would collapse):
#   label | fails_before | fails_after | pipewire log.level | fails_settled (optional)
# fails_* are comma-separated "<section>.<key>=<value>"; empty means nothing failing.
# fails_settled answers the re-check after a sleep; empty = fails_after, "-" = nothing failing.
# fails_before/fails_after "!" = the status command printed nothing (crashed).
